label: Remote agent (MCP)
description: Calls one tool of an MCP server as a step, for example an agent published as an MCP tool. Plug an “App connector (MCP)” block into its tools input and name the tool.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: The MCP server (App connector) whose tool this step calls.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go when the agent has answered: connect the next step, or Finish.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: The tool's name, as “Browse tools” on the connector lists it.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: The tool's arguments; each value may insert data with {{ state.<field> }}.

output.title: Save the answer in
output.description: The data field that receives the agent's answer. Choose `messages` to add it to the chat.

approve.title: Ask a person before it runs
approve.description: Pause with an approval card showing what will be sent; a rejection skips the agent.
